differences.title: 1. PERFORMANCE
differences.leftDesc: Built in Zig, Bun boasts significantly faster startup and execution speeds for JavaScript and TypeScript.
differences.rightDesc: Node.js offers a robust and well-established performance profile, optimized over years of development.

differences.title: 2. TOOLING
differences.leftDesc: Bun includes built-in bundler, transpiler, task runner, and package manager for a streamlined dev experience.
differences.rightDesc: Node.js relies on an extensive ecosystem of separate tools for bundling, testing, and managing dependencies.

differences.title: 3. RUNTIME ARCHITECTURE
differences.leftDesc: Bun runs as a single, efficient binary, simplifying installation and reducing overhead.
differences.rightDesc: Node.js typically uses separate processes and relies on `npm` or `yarn` for package management.

differences.title: 4. COMPATIBILITY
differences.leftDesc: Bun aims for high compatibility with Node.js APIs, facilitating migration.
differences.rightDesc: Node.js offers mature and stable native APIs, with extensive community support.

differences.title: 5. PACKAGE MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: Bun's `bun install` is dramatically faster than npm/yarn, with its own optimized cache.
differences.rightDesc: Node.js ecosystem relies on `npm` or `yarn`, which are battle-tested but slower.

differences.title: 6. TYPESCRIPT SUPPORT
differences.leftDesc: Bun supports TypeScript out-of-the-box without needing separate compilation steps.
differences.rightDesc: Node.js requires a transpilation step (e.g., via `tsc` or Babel) for TypeScript.

differences.title: 7. COMMUNITY & MATURITY
differences.leftDesc: Bun is newer, rapidly evolving, and gaining strong community traction.
differences.rightDesc: Node.js has a massive, mature community and a vast library of established packages.
